raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions has 5012 rows but only 4866 distinct txn_ids, and the ids form a contiguous range (900001–904866), so the extra rows look like re-delivered copies of the same transactions rather than id collisions. silver_transactions has no deduplication, so 137 posted transactions appear more than once and gold totals are double-counted.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.72, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) r WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED'"}}
